text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~ mhm. Just as the proprietress 
suspected, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
For many of the academy's students who 
spend their days absorbed in training, 
fatigue and strain continuously 
accumulate, to greater or lesser degrees—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That one over there is moving her 
arms awkwardly, and the other one is 
subconsciously favoring her right leg.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there are quite a lot of girls 
in need of some R&R here.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Which means... It's time for Yukoma Ryokan 
to step in♪ Let's start promoting right 
away, Landlady!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Pamphlets made just for today, 
novelty goods, a massage trial session—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
With my 'hanging monkfish butchering,' 
people's attention is sure to jump right 
up!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
It's monkfish. Fresh monkfish. I brought 
one that's super fresh! It's totally 
'Insta-worthy', it'll be a massive hit for 
sure!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"...I suppose I'll check with the 
Chairwoman to see if we're allowed to do 
it."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If you turn me down, well... maybe I'll 
just borrow the kitchen, make staff meals, 
and then head home? Sounds good, right?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm praying that they'll give us 
their approval♪
